mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% in a month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS shows sustained growth and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops by more than 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 6% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase, it signals a recovery in the labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 6% and PAYEMS increases, but 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% YoY, it signals accommodative monetary policy despite inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%, but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals a weakening demand in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases by more than 10% YoY and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY and industrial production (INDPRO) is stagnant or declining, it signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth < 1% and INDPRO stagnant/declining
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY growth < 1% and INDPRO is stagnant/declining, but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
